text: Predictive maintenance uses vibration and temperature sensor data to forecast machine failures before they happen.
Anomaly detection with PCA and FFT flags unusual spindle vibration patterns in CNC machines.
The conveyor belt is stopped automatically when the camera detects a foreign object intrusion.
RT-DETR is a real-time transformer object detector used for visual inspection on production lines.
Retrieval-augmented generation grounds large language model answers in retrieved documents.
Vector databases such as Qdrant and ChromaDB store embeddings for approximate nearest neighbour search.
BM25 is a lexical ranking function that scores documents by term frequency and inverse document frequency.
Reciprocal rank fusion combines several ranked lists without needing to calibrate their scores.
Process mining reconstructs business workflows from event logs to find bottlenecks and rework loops.
Object-centric event logs (OCEL) track how orders, items and invoices interact within one process.
Error code E-4711 means the hydraulic pressure sensor on press 3 has lost calibration.
Databricks pipelines replaced legacy SSRS reports and cut dashboard refresh time.
MLflow tracks experiments, parameters and metrics so trained models can be reproduced.
Knowledge graphs in Neo4j link entities so an agent can follow relationships between machines and incidents.
Kubernetes deploys containerised model services and restarts them when health checks fail.
